|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Adds 2 to the power of any creature vehicle he "rides." While "riding" a Tauntaun, adds one battle destiny. You may ignore any destiny draw for Tauntaun Bones.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tauntaun Handler (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Creature vehicles he ‘rides’ are power +2. While ‘riding’ a Tauntaun, adds one battle destiny. May cancel any result of Tauntaun Bones.” '''What changed:''' “Adds 2 to the” → “Creature vehicles he ‘rides’ are”; “of any creature vehicle he "rides."” → “+2.”; “"riding"” → “‘riding’”; “You may ignore” → “May cancel”; “destiny draw for” → “result of”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 20. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
